development_exposed: yes - batch1, used for tuning/validation in several modules

model.output: temperature at 5,404 non-sensor nodes, same time as the sensor readings
model.inputs: 16 virtual-sensor readings at time t (exact CFD node values), heat load Q, coolant flow, time since load start t

linear_baseline.description: Piecewise-linear interpolation of the 16 sensors (Delaunay on sensors); outside the sensor hull the nearest sensor value is used. No training.

sensor_node_policy: The reconstructed map is the model output at all 5,420 nodes, including the 16 sensor nodes (as in the evidence package). Field error metrics exclude the 16 sensor nodes; Tmax and hotspot use all 5,420 nodes.

metric_definitions.rmse_K: sqrt(mean over 5,404 non-sensor nodes of (prediction - CFD)^2), one snapshot, point-weighted
metric_definitions.mean_C: arithmetic mean over all 5,420 map nodes (point-weighted; not the CFD area-weighted monitor)
metric_definitions.hotspot_distance_mm: distance between hottest node of the reconstructed map and of the CFD map

processing: reconstructed map = float64 mean of the 10 saved per-seed DeepONet predictions (seeds 0-9)
frames every 5 s of simulated time (180 of 1800 snapshots)
uint16 quantisation, 1 mK step (display only); card values and metrics from full precision
